goals: Maintain the progression-gated one-way return system for Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric using one shared placed Dragonbound Waystone, an Imbued Void Pearl, and a cooldown-based Dragonbound Staff.

Preserve the accepted server-owned channel, exact-destination safety, persistent anchor, loss protection, recipes, configuration migration, discovery behavior, geometry, and art without expanding into a general waypoint or teleport system.
scope: Maintain the accepted Canary 5 behavior while Canary 6 adds only server-owned vanilla Enderman teleport activation sound and portal-particle feedback to the shared channel lifecycle.

Preserve the 40-tick default channel, 1,200-tick Staff cooldown, exact current recipes, one-click and mouse-release-independent channel lifecycle, exact arrival at blockY + 3/16, recipe-book and JEI discovery seam, and success-only consumption and cooldown behavior.
Retain exact accepted Canary 5 and focused-runtime-passed Canary 4 rollback artifacts together with the Dragonbound-owned Staff art and the separately licensed Matcha Stable Void snapshot and notice.

exclusions: Multiple destinations, waypoint lists, portals, home commands, arbitrary coordinates, nearby-position fallback, XP costs, durability, charges, pet or group teleport, and other feature or balance changes.
Recipe, dependency, configuration, timing, geometry, art, item identity, behavior, or scope changes during this migration.
Mod Menu polish and dedicated-server validation remain deferred; the accepted evidence is the recorded client and singleplayer scope only.
Other projects and their source, status, artifacts, dependencies, and ownership records remain outside this project.

Minecraft deployment, either experimental Test Slot, accepted physical-baseline changes, Test Instance Manager mutation, Minecraft launch, and protected gameplay-instance access during this migration.
Redistribution of the embedded Matcha/Klei bitmap without independently satisfying its CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 attribution, non-commercial, and share-alike terms.
